name: Level Up
summary: An upload button whose arrow launches away and leaves a water gauge that rises with the upload
about: Level Up is an ocean-blue upload button that really reads the file you pick or drop. The gauge box squashes, the arrow launches upward and a measuring tube springs up with scale marks that light up as the water passes them. When full, the water sloshes, splashes droplets, turns mint and becomes a springy tick. Files over 25 MB are refused with a shake and a clear message.
how: Press Upload file to choose a file, drop one on the button, or try the sample file.
The gauge squashes, the arrow launches up and a tube with scale marks springs into its place.
Water with bubbles rises inside the tube, each mark lights up as it is passed, and the label counts megabytes and percent.
When full the water sloshes and splashes, turns mint and becomes a tick, then the button resets; a file over 25 MB shakes and shows an error.
